name: upsmflproduction
description: UPS MFL league platform. This root manifest exists ONLY to provide npm aliases for the fantasy ingestion CLI and the test suite — the repo's real code lives in worker/ (its own package.json), pipelines/ (Python) and site/ (static).
//type: ⚠️ There is deliberately NO "type" field. Adding "type": "module" here would break tests/lineup_parser_test.js, which is CommonJS and relies on require()/__dirname working because no root package.json existed. New test files use .mjs so they can import ESM without needing one.
//deps: ⚠️ Deliberately NO dependencies and NO devDependencies. Every script below is stdlib-only (python3 / node 22). Adding a package here would introduce the repo's first root node_modules and its first npm install step in CI, which no existing workflow has.

scripts.test: npm run test:node && npm run test:python && npm run test:espn && npm run test:isolation
